source: ZXNAME0000XZ reorganizes the same dependencies. Blocks ofZXMATH0000XZ andZXMATH0001XZ are brought near the compute units, score tiles are produced and consumed locally, and only compact row-wise statistics plus the output need to persist across tiles.[4, 5]
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 重新组织相同的依赖关系。 ZXMATH0000XZ 和 ZXMATH0001XZ 块被带到计算单元附近，分数图块在本地生成和消耗，并且只有紧凑的行统计数据加上输出需要跨图块持久保存。 [4, 5]
